title: Parseval identity for a finite family
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, and let $\mathcal U$ be a finite family of subsets of the coordinate set $\{1,\ldots,n\}$. For each such subset $S$, write $\widehat f(S)=\mathbb E_x\bigl[f(x)\prod_{i\in S}x_i\bigr]$, where $x$ is uniform on the sign cube. Then $\sum_{S\in\mathcal U}\widehat f(S)^2+\sum_{S\notin\mathcal U}\widehat f(S)^2=1$, with the second sum over all subsets of the coordinate set.
hypotheses_covered: A function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the signs $\{-1,1\}$
A finite family of subsets of the coordinate set
